question.en: Why doesn't Aunt Jennifer tell anyone how old she is?
question.zh: 为什么詹妮弗姑母不告诉别人她有多大年纪？

sentences.en: Why doesn't Aunt Jennifer tell anyone how old she is?
sentences.zh: 为什么詹妮弗姑母不告诉别人她有多大年纪？

sentences.en: My aunt Jennifer is an actress.
sentences.zh: 我的姑母詹妮弗是个演员。

sentences.en: She must be at least thirty-five years old.

sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: she often appears on the stage as a young girl.
sentences.zh: 她却常在舞台上扮演小姑娘。

sentences.en: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗很快又要参加一个新剧的演出。

sentences.en: This time, she will be a girl of seventeen.
sentences.zh: 这一次，她将扮演一个17岁的少女。

sentences.en: In the play, she must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings.
sentences.zh: 演出时她必须穿一件鲜红色的连衣裙和黑色的长筒袜。

chunks.x: in a bright red dress and long black stockings

sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: she had to wear short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress.
sentences.zh: 她不得不穿短袜和一件色彩鲜艳的橘红色衣服。

sentences.en: If anyone ever asks her how old she is,
sentences.zh: 一旦有人问起她有多大年纪，

sentences.en: she always answers, 'Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!'
sentences.zh: 她总是回答：“亲爱的，长成大人真可怕啊！”
